criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Purdue FeatureServer FID 777 identifies Triangle / SOTRI at 103 University St; first-party chapter About page gives 103 N University Street. A separate 2018 IndianaMap LiDAR-derived building-footprint feature corroborates the match (IoU 0.8561; centroid separation 1.42 m). The 20-vertex Purdue ring was read from its retained raw response and compared to the candidate shell.
criteria.finding: Identity and broad footprint are strongly supported; neither outline is a surveyed wall line.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Independent reopen comparison places all 20 expected GIS vertices within 0.000014 m of candidate base/roof shell vertices. The asset remains in campus coordinates and source polygon orientation is preserved. Local transformed GIS area is 719.34 m2; independent footprint area is 758.91 m2.
criteria.finding: Plan geometry is faithful to Purdue GIS, with 1.42 m centroid separation and 3.31 m boundary Hausdorff difference against the independent generalized footprint. Geographic conversion is explicitly approximate and not survey-grade.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Official chapter photo supports a low-slope/flat roof with dark parapet trim and visually about three levels. The modeled total height is 10.65 m, explicitly tagged as an estimate. Reopened mesh Z bounds are 0.000 to 10.650 m.
criteria.finding: No measured height or roof plan was found. Purdue GIS reports one level while the photo appears multi-storey; GIS vertical fields have undocumented semantics, and the sampled DSM cannot establish building height. Model correctly records these as uncertain/estimated.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The first-party chapter photo supports buff brick, dark vertical windows, raised entrance/terrace, and a central gabled canopy. The model contains repeated tall window bays, a west-side entrance, raised terrace, steps, canopy, and a parapet.
criteria.finding: Rendered candidate is a simplified envelope with sparse window bays and broad blank wall spans compared with the photo's dense, vertically articulated facade and distinct wing treatment. Entry side/location and detailed window layout remain inferred from one oblique view.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Fresh Blender reopen confirmed the expected named scene/collection, one mesh object, 2070 vertices, 1545 faces, 0 nonmanifold edges, no absolute external image paths; candidate remains a self-contained massing library in campus coordinates. Raw Purdue GIS and chapter page snapshots, independent footprint source, metadata, comparison, preview, and reopen validation are retained.
criteria.finding: Export name/path and evidence package are complete. A separate collection-link portable probe also reopens the collection successfully.

findings: PASS at the stipulated threshold of 8/10.
The model matches its source identity and footprint well and is technically reopenable/portable.
Height/story count and fine facade dimensions remain estimates; visual fidelity is intentionally massing-level and visibly simpler than the available photograph.
A 2018 independent outline supports the match but is generalized, not a structural wall survey.
